changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE vermietung_abrechnung (id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,buchung_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES buchung(id),revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),erstellt TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL,korrekturgrund VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,pdf BYTEA NOT NULL,UNIQUE(buchung_id,revision));
